name: modernbert-base-mednli
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from answerdotai/ModernBERT-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder, alternating local (128) and global attention (every 3rd layer)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.15B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-18. 3-class clinical NLI; recorded as task 'other' because the catalog has no text-classification task. The base column is the un-fine-tuned encoder run zero-shot through an entailment-scoring prompt, so the 40-point MedNLI gap measures fine-tuning on MedNLI, not a general gain.

benchmarks.name: MedNLI test accuracy
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Model | MedNLI Acc | MedNLI F1 | RadNLI Acc | RadNLI F1': this model 81.4 vs row 'ModernBERT-base (zero-shot)' 41.2. Zero-shot base = entailment-score NLI prompt on the un-fine-tuned encoder.

benchmarks.name: RadNLI test accuracy (zero-shot transfer)
benchmarks.config: Same table: 52.1 vs base 48.5. Small margin on out-of-domain data.
